comments.text: Do the two days between Christmas and New Year count against our 25?
No, they come on top. I added a line to the page to make it clearer.
The team calendar is here: https://calendar.lumen.example/team. Add yours before asking.
Train tickets: book with the company account on https://www.sncf-connect.com, then the receipt comes by email.
Est-ce qu’on peut changer de jour fixe d’une semaine à l’autre ?
Oui, tant que l’équipe est prévenue la veille. Je l’ajoute à la charte.
